arxiv-2103-10493.title: Image Synthesis for Data Augmentation in Medical CT using Deep Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2103-10493.creator: Arjun Krishna, Kedar Bartake, Chuang Niu, Ge Wang, Youfang Lai, Xun Jia, Klaus Mueller
arxiv-2103-10493.description: Abstract Abstract Deep learning has shown great promise for CT image reconstruction, in particular to enable low dose imaging and integrated diagnostics. These merits, however, stand at great odds with the low availability of diverse image data which are needed to train these neural networks.

arxiv-2109-02445.title: Multi-modal Program Inference: a Marriage of Pre-trained Language Models and Component-based Synthesis
arxiv-2109-02445.creator: Kia Rahmani, Mohammad Raza, Sumit Gulwani, Vu Le, Daniel Morris, Arjun Radhakrishna, Gustavo Soares, Ashish Tiwari
arxiv-2109-02445.description: Abstract . Multi-modal program synthesis refers to the task of synthesizing programs (code) from their specification given in different forms, such as a combination of natural language and examples. Examples provide a precise but incomplete specification, and natural language provides an ambiguous but more “complete” task description.

arxiv-2204-04669.title: Generalized Calogero-Sutherland models for Kondo physics in the Luttinger liquid
arxiv-2204-04669.creator: Hua-Chen Zhang, Ying-Hai Wu, Hong-Hao Tu
arxiv-2204-04669.description: Abstract We propose a series of models with inverse-square interactions, for which the ground states have an exact closed form, that describe one localized spin- 1 / 2 1/2 Kondo impurity coupled to Luttinger liquids of itinerant bosons or fermions in the continuum or on a lattice.

arxiv-2209-01047.title: Anomalous collective dynamics of auto-chemotactic populations
arxiv-2209-01047.creator: Jasper van der Kolk, Florian Raßhofer, Richard Swiderski, Astik Haldar, Abhik Basu, Erwin Frey
arxiv-2209-01047.description: Abstract While the role of local interactions in nonequilibrium phase transitions is well studied, a fundamental understanding of the effects of long-range interactions is lacking. We study the critical dynamics of reproducing agents subject to auto-chemotactic interactions and limited resources.

arxiv-2211-01123.title: Multicriticality in Yang-Lee edge singularity
arxiv-2211-01123.creator: Máté Lencsés, Alessio Miscioscia, Giuseppe Mussardo, Gábor Takács
arxiv-2211-01123.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Máté Lencsés, Alessio Miscioscia, Giuseppe Mussardo, Gábor Takács. In this paper we study the non-unitary deformations of the two-dimensional Tricritical Ising Model obtained by coupling its two spin ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}_{2} odd operators to imaginary magnetic fields. Varying the strengths of these imaginary magnetic fields and adjusting correspondingly the coupling constants of the two spin ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}_{2} even fields, we establish the presence of two universality classes of infrared fixed points on the critical surface.

arxiv-2401-05452.title: Cuff-less Arterial Blood Pressure Waveform Synthesis from Single-site PPG using Transformer & Frequency-domain Learning This work is supported in part by UK Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC) under the grants: EP/T021063/1 and EP/T021020/1.
arxiv-2401-05452.creator: Muhammad Wasim Nawaz 1 , Muhammad Ahmad Tahir 2 , Ahsan Mehmood 2 , Muhammad Mahboob Ur Rahman 2 , Kashif Riaz 2 , Qammer H. Abbasi 3 , 4
arxiv-2401-05452.description: Abstract We develop and evaluate two novel purpose-built deep learning (DL) models for synthesis of the arterial blood pressure (ABP) waveform in a cuff-less manner, using a single-site photoplethysmography (PPG) signal. We train and evaluate our DL models on the data of 209 subjects from the public UCI dataset on cuff-less blood pressure (CLBP) estimation.

arxiv-2401-14014.title: Theoretical Analysis of Explicit Averaging and Novel Sign Averaging in Comparison-Based Search Thanks: This study was partially supported by JSPS KAKENHI under Grant Number 19H04179.
arxiv-2401-14014.creator: Daiki Morinaga, Youhei Akimoto
arxiv-2401-14014.description: Abstract In black-box optimization, noise in the objective function is inevitable. Noise disrupts the ranking of candidate solutions in comparison-based optimization, possibly deteriorating the search performance compared with a noiseless scenario. Explicit averaging takes the sample average of noisy objective function values and is widely used as a simple and versatile noise-handling technique.

arxiv-2503-05518.title: ALICE Fast Interaction Trigger Upgrade Journal: Nuclear Instruments and Methods A
arxiv-2503-05518.creator: Krystian Roslon, for the ALICE collaboration
arxiv-2503-05518.description: Abstract This proceeding provides an expanded overview of the Fast Interaction Trigger (FIT) system performance, focusing on new developments such as the prospective integration of the ALICE Low-Level Front-End Device (ALFRED) into the Detector Control System (DCS) and an upgraded Front-End Electronics (FEE) approach to enhance dynamic range and operational reliability.

arxiv-2603-13293.title: A Robust Framework for Secure Cardiovascular Risk Prediction: An Architectural Case Study of Differentially Private Federated Learning Journal: Expert Systems with Applications
arxiv-2603-13293.creator: Rodrigo Tertulino, Laércio Alencar

britannica-1911-fang.title: Fang (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-fang.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-fang.description: Article 'Fang' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 10), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. a powerful African people occupying the Gabun district north of the Ogowé river in French Congo. Their name means “men.” They call themselves Pa n we, Fa n we and Fa n with highly nasalized n. They are a finely-made race of chocolate colour; some few are very dark, but these are of slave origin. They have bright expressive oval faces with prominent cheek-bones.

pmc-10740983.title: The Complex of p-Tyr42 RhoA and p-p65/RelA in Response to LPS Regulates the Expression of Phosphoglycerate Kinase 1
pmc-10740983.creator: Oyungerel Dogsom, Amir Hamza, Shohel Mahmud, Jung-Ki Min, Yoon-Beom Lee, Jae-Bong Park, Reto Asmis
pmc-10740983.description: Inflammation plays a crucial role in tumorigenesis, primarily mediated by NF-κB. RhoA GTPases are instrumental in regulating the activation of NF-κB. Specifically, the phosphorylation of Tyrosine 42 on RhoA ensures the activation of NF-κB by directly activating the IKKβ associated with IKKγ (NEMO).

pmc-10744204.title: Genome-Wide Analysis of Sweet Potato Ammonium Transporter (AMT): Influence on Nitrogen Utilization, Storage Root Development and Yield
pmc-10744204.creator: Ya-Yi Meng, Ning Wang, Hai-Yan Zhang, Ran Xu, Cheng-Cheng Si
pmc-10744204.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Ammonium, as a major inorganic source of nitrogen (N) for sweet potato N utilization and growth, is specifically transported by ammonium transporters (AMTs). However, the activities of AMT family members in sweet potatoes have not been analyzed.

pmc-11428592.title: Machine Learning Algorithm for Predicting Distant Metastasis of T1 and T2 Gallbladder Cancer Based on SEER Database
pmc-11428592.creator: Zhentian Guo, Zongming Zhang, Limin Liu, Yue Zhao, Zhuo Liu, Chong Zhang, Hui Qi, Jinqiu Feng, Peijie Yao, Haiming Yuan, Yunfeng Wu, Maria Francesca Spadea
pmc-11428592.description: (1) Background: This study seeks to employ a machine learning (ML) algorithm to forecast the risk of distant metastasis (DM) in patients with T1 and T2 gallbladder cancer (GBC); (2) Methods: Data of patients diagnosed with T1 and T2 GBC was obtained from SEER, encompassing the period from 2004 to 2015, were utilized to apply seven ML algorithms.

pmc-11663797.title: A Content Analysis of Nicotine Descriptors on the Front of Vape Packaging in the United Kingdom
pmc-11663797.creator: Allison Ford, Anne Marie MacKintosh, Amber Morgan, Daniel Jones, Crawford Moodie, Kate Hunt, Kathryn Angus
pmc-11663797.description: IntroductionThe Tobacco and Related Products Regulations (TRPR) 2016 require consumers in the United Kingdom to be informed about the presence of nicotine in vaping products. However, there is misunderstanding among some young people and adults around the strength of products. We examined how nicotine content is displayed on the front of vape packaging in the United Kingdom.

pmc-11715171.title: Association of brain MRI signatures with Alzheimer Disease CSF biomarkers
pmc-11715171.creator: You Cheng, Karthik Gopinath, Benjamin Billot, Juan Eugenio Iglesias, Alexandra Touroutoglou, Pia Kivisäkk, Chao‐Yi Wu, Hiroko H Dodge, Bradley T. T Hyman, Steven E Arnold, Sudeshna Das
pmc-11715171.description: BackgroundThe relationship between CSF measures of Alzheimer disease (AD) pathologies and their neurodegenerative signatures is not fully understood. This study seeks to employ machine learning approaches on clinical MRI data to identify patterns associated with amyloid and tau, aiming to guide diagnosis and therapeutic interventions.MethodWe selected brain volumes that differed significantly between AD pathology and control groups.

pmc-12447787.title: Gandhi and the Decolonisation of Global Health
pmc-12447787.creator: Vikash R. Keshri
pmc-12447787.description: The decolonisation of the global health movement has been a matter of intense debate over the last few years. Recent political actions by leaders in the Global North, particularly the closure of the United States Agency for International Development (USAID), call for stronger action by actors in the Global South to strengthen global health.

pmc-12512481.title: Fire needle acupuncture for postherpetic neuralgia of the oral mucosa after initial misdiagnosis: a case report
pmc-12512481.creator: Jingxing Li, Jiachun Xu, Zhaohua Jiao, Chuyi Zhang, Yan Li, Zhen Zhou
pmc-12512481.description: BackgroundThe incidence of herpes zoster of the oral mucosa is relatively low, and there are rare clinical reports, which might be misdiagnosed as oral infection or oral ulcer.Case presentationHere, we report the case of a 40-year-old Chinese female patient who was misdiagnosed with oral infection at first, where the 15-day treatment at the other clinic did not relieve her pain.

pmc-12581337.title: Perceived social support and depression: longitudinal mediating roles of gratitude and meaning in life
pmc-12581337.creator: H M Tian, Y Q Zhou, X L Chang, Y F Wang
pmc-12581337.description: ObjectiveThis study uses two longitudinal batches of data to explore the relationship between perceived social support and depression, and the chain mediating effect of gratitude and meaning in life in college students.MethodsA total of 833 participants completed the questionnaire survey, including perceived social support multidimensional scale, gratitude scale, meaning in Life scale and depression subscale of DASS-21.

pmc-12608915.title: Unlocking Mangiferin: A Therapeutic Candidate Revolutionizing Liver Disease Therapy
pmc-12608915.creator: Jihang Xie, Sijing Su, Jianfa Wu, Xing Yang, Qian Zhang, Xiaojiang Shen, Linlin Zhao, Ting Wang, Nana Feng, Jinsong Su, Yi Zhang
pmc-12608915.description: Mangiferin (MF), a natural component widely found in fruits, vegetables, and herbs, has garnered increasing attention for its potent antioxidative properties and therapeutic potential. This bioactive xanthone compound plays a crucial role in mitigating oxidative stress, which is a key factor in the pathogenesis of various diseases, including liver diseases.

pmc-12935275.title: How does the climate risk affect the firm growth: Evidence from China
pmc-12935275.creator: Yanxue Zhang, Zirong Li
pmc-12935275.description: Corporate development is threatened by climate risk, which challenges business operations and long-term planning at an unprecedented scale and frequency. Based on the challenge–threat theory framework, this study uses data from Chinese A-share listed companies from 2008 to 2022 to systematically explore the effect of climate risk on firm growth and its transmission mechanisms.

pmc-13093703.title: Safety evaluation of the food enzyme pectinesterase from the non‐genetically modified Aspergillus luchuensis strain CBS 148463
pmc-13093703.creator: EFSA Panel on Food Enzymes (FEZ), Holger Zorn, José Manuel Barat Baviera, Claudia Bolognesi, Francesco Catania, Gabriele Gadermaier, Ralf Greiner, Baltasar Mayo, Alicja Mortensen, Yrjö Henrik Roos, Marize L. M. Solano, Henk Van Loveren, Laurence Vernis, Jaime Aguilera, Magdalena Andryszkiewicz, Ana
pmc-13093703.description: The food enzyme pectinesterase (pectin pectylhydrolase; EC 3.1.1.11) is produced with the non‐genetically modified Aspergillus luchuensis strain CBS 148463 by Solyve. The food enzyme was considered free from viable cells of the production organism. The food enzyme is intended to be used in 12 food manufacturing processes.

pmc-13426273.title: “Why would I need more?”: How age shapes UK consumers’ perceptions of dietary protein and responses to educational interventions
pmc-13426273.creator: Holly Giles, Charlotte Clark, Lisa Methven, Stephanie P. Bull, Victoria Norton, Joe Gallagher, Marianthi Faka, Elisa Glover, Stella Lignou
pmc-13426273.description: Adequate protein intake has an important role in maintaining musculoskeletal health, independence and strength during ageing. To design age-appropriate nutritional interventions, it is necessary to understand public knowledge, attitudes and perceptions surrounding dietary protein. Thus, the study aimed to investigate knowledge of protein requirements, functions, and sources, as well as attitudes towards educational materials surrounding these topics.

pmc-13452168.title: Establishing a biomarker set for the diagnosis of apple replant disease using qPCR
pmc-13452168.creator: Luisa Baader, Susan Schröpfer, Benye Liu, Stefanie Reim, Traud Winkelmann, Nils Orth, Jiem Krueger, Georg Guggenberger, Jens Boy, Jacqueline Kaldun, Eva Lehndorff, Nele Meyer, Ludger Beerhues, Kristin Hauschild, Henryk Flachowsky
pmc-13452168.description: Apple replant disease (ARD) is a soil-borne disease that arises from replanting apple trees on land previously used for apple cultivation. There is interest in biomarkers that can reliably assess the severity of ARD by quantifying how strongly apple plants react to the disease in soils of different agro-environments.

pmc-13563879.title: Mushroom management style as a predictor of teachers’ quiet quitting behavior
pmc-13563879.creator: Erdal Meriç
pmc-13563879.description: BackgroundThe mushroom management style refers to a management approach where employees’ access to information is restricted and they are not included in decision-making processes. Quiet quitting, conversely, it refers to employees only performing their mandatory duties without resigning, avoiding putting extra effort into their work.

pmc-13680356.title: Molecular mechanisms of NLR proteins in inflammasome activation
pmc-13680356.creator: Yichao Liu, Kexin Ji, Liman Zhang
pmc-13680356.description: Nucleotide-binding domain and leucine-rich repeat-containing proteins (NLRs) are central mediators of inflammasome signaling, activating caspase-1 to drive pyroptotic cell death and pro-inflammatory responses. Although NLR activation is generally thought to involve conformational rearrangements that oligomerize their N- or C-terminal death domains to nucleate ASC or pro-caspase-1 oligomerization, the molecular mechanisms that enable these transitions vary substantially among family members.
